primary_question: Among contemporaneous opportunities already G1 warm and PVR>50, does the first new CP1 receipt add discrimination for subsequent new capital? Not a test of the entire CP1/PVR composite confirmation or N1 cost promotion.
scope: Same 407 frozen technology stocks and 2023-12-29 decision to 2026-10-27 terminal, source snapshot pinned to experiment one.
risk_set: Full pool including never funded: continuous I state, first already-observed original full-Q I event anchor, common nonportfolio S0 eligibility, G1>=2, PVR>50, known valid PVR scale and CP1 observer ready; no prior qualifying CP1 confirmation in this I epoch.
qualification_retained: current snapshot cap>10bn and issuer/sector identities
original stock/sector RS readiness and freshness only
sector observed today and sector E0 up
case: First qualifying CP1 receipt in an I epoch; one case per I epoch, not every repeated receipt. Same-day first observation anchor allowed and separately disclosed.
control: Same risk set and day without CP1 receipt; no requirement to remain unconfirmed in future.
matching: Exact decision date, true sector, G1 grade and anchor-age bin 0-20/21-62/>=63 effective observations; nearest absolute anchor-to-date log price runup, distance <=max of both known PVR daily scales. One control per case; control epoch at most once as control, may later be a case.
ordering: SHA256 of symbol/source/visible I-start/known observation anchor/decision date only, then deterministic ID tie-break. No future end dates or final ordinal segment number.
coverage_gate: Publish all cases, matched/unmatched reasons, stocks/sectors/dates, age/runup/volatility/PVR balance before reading economic outcomes. No automatic relaxation or extra dimensions. Inadequate common support yields limited/inconclusive scope, never zero unmatched P&L.
weights: Primary one equal 1m shadow initial-cash pair per matched case; case-stock equal robustness weights fixed before outcomes. No rematching for cost2, fill or closure. Control role reuse bounded and disclosed.
execution: Existing experiment-one run_event with Q true only at matched decision, starts at decision date with no seed shares or gains. Next eligible open, original day-expiry, no later reapplication in this event. Uniform original I/E0 exit, actual costs, split/dividend/T+1/raw quote and terminal assets.
all_events: Both legs of every frozen matched pair included even if not filled, still held or awaiting entitlements. Unmatched cases disclosed outside difference estimator.
tail: Existing net_pnl/(buy_gross+buy_fees)>=30%, realized and terminal-valued/claims separately disclosed. Pair-tail partition if either leg has >=30% return, ordinary complement; only evaluation, no trading effect. Own-arm tail contributions and continuous contribution ranks also shown.
effects: Delta=sum(C-N)=saved_negative_loss-foregone_positive. Pair-tail+ordinary delta=total. No preconfirmation gains included. Profit factor/payoff and capital-days reported; win rate descriptive only.
background: After matching freeze only, reuse experiment-one full I-event ledger to disclose whole first-participation costs and failures by ever CP1-confirmed status. This is background, not a 2% probe strategy or additive incremental alpha. Never equate unconfirmed with failed.
verdict: Pareto ordinary/tail plus net improvement sufficient, not necessary. Larger tail benefit covering ordinary cost increase is a positive tradeoff, not failure. Cost/weight reversal, poor coverage or pre-known imbalance means inconclusive. Negative result scoped to CP1 receipt increment under warm/PVR>50, not all composite confirmation or N1.
correctness: Matching IDs/features fixed as of decision; truncated future cache leaves matching prefix unchanged. All required exact strata/caliper/control-role constraints; reusable native Decimal fee/cash/share/action/NAV checks plus independent available cash; terminal holdings/claims retained.
sample: Representative matched/unmatched, future-confirming control, same-anchor-day and delayed, no-fill and corporate/terminal cases when present; deterministic examples, no profit selection.
budget: Only sample then one full paired-unit calculation, 300s compute budget excluding development. Report matching/sample readiness promptly. No portfolio matrix, thresholds, new indicator models, account/product access or other task changes.
limitations: Deterministic observational matching cannot establish causality. One first confirmation per I epoch and uniform E0 exit do not reproduce full P1/N1 pyramiding, CP1 tranche exits, finite shared cash or ACT.
